title: Essential: Final power
description: Essential Criteria – The student's final answer for the power consumed by R1 must be 8 W (or equivalent with correct units).

title: Essential: Final specific charge
description: Essential Criteria – The student's final answer for the specific charge (q/m) must be 0.1 C/kg (or equivalent with correct units).

title: Important: Induced EMF calculation
description: Important Criteria – The student must correctly apply Faraday's law (E = n * ΔB/Δt * S) using the slope from the graph (2 T/s) and convert area to m².

title: Important: Circuit current
description: Important Criteria – The student must correctly use Ohm's law for the full circuit (I = E / (R1 + R2 + r)) to find the steady current.

title: Important: Capacitor voltage
description: Important Criteria – The student must correctly identify that the capacitor voltage equals the voltage across R2 (U = I * R2) in the steady state.

title: Important: Particle force balance
description: Important Criteria – The student must set up the equilibrium condition for the particle: electric force (qU/d) equals gravitational force (mg).

title: Optional: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria – The student demonstrates consistent unit conversion (e.g., cm² to m², cm to m) throughout the solution.

title: Pitfall: Graph misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria – Penalize using an incorrect slope from the B-t graph (e.g., using B value instead of ΔB/Δt).

title: Pitfall: Sign/area error
description: Pitfall Criteria – Penalize forgetting to convert the cross-sectional area from cm² to m², leading to a power-of-10 error.
